jobs.title: Customer Education
jobs.description: About Peec AI AI search is changing how brands are discovered and chosen. People now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google’s AI answers what they used to search for, and AI assistants increasingly shape the journey from discovery to purchase. Winning customers now means winning over the AI systems that influence their decisions. Peec AI is an AI search platform that helps marketing teams understand and improve how their brands are discovered, represented, and recommended. We show them where they stand, what’s shaping it, and where to act. Since launching in January 2025, Peec AI has passed $20M ARR and 4,000+ paying customers. We’re a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, with 100+ people across our Berlin HQ and our New York office. About the role Peec ships something new almost every week. Most customers hear about it late, and some never do. We're hiring a Customer Education Manager to own how customers learn Peec. You'll own the product docs, the changelog, product updates and in-app communication, and turn every release into something a busy marketer understands in a minute. You'll sit in product marketing and report to our founding product marketer. You'll work every day with product managers and engineers to understand what's shipping, with customer success to see where customers get stuck, and with the growth team to see what actually changes how people use the product. What you'll do Own the product docs. Rebuild them around the jobs customers come to do, not around the menu. Keep them current with every release, and make them easy to read for people and for the AI assistants our customers now ask first. Run the changelog and product updates. Every release gets a clear entry the day it ships. You write the regular product update and the announcement for bigger launches, and decide what deserves which. Write in-app communication.
